title: Great stockpot, perfect for everyone!
text: Great stockpot, perfect for everyone!. This is a great stockpot for the money. First, it is super attractive, well made and lightweight. I love this color, too, it blends with all my kitchen decor. I love Rachel Ray products as they always provide good products at reasonable prices. This 6 quart size is great for making pasta and soups. This would make an excellent bridal shower or housewarming present for anyone. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Brights Nonstick Stock Pot/Stockpot with Lid - 6 Quart, Gray
features: EVEN HEAT DISTRIBUTION: Durable nonstick stockpot is crafted from fast and even heating aluminum with a stylish two-tone exterior
DURABLE NONSTICK: Stockpot features enhanced, long-lasting nonstick provides easy food release and quick cleanup
VERSATILE COOKWARE: The versatile nonstick cooking pot comes in the perfect 6-quart size to handle family-sized one-pot meals
DESIGNED FOR VERSATILITY: The stockpot’s comfortable grippy handles are double-riveted for extra strength and a shatter resistant glass lid seals in heat and flavor
description: One-pot wonder meals are in easy everyday reach with the Rachael Ray(r) Classic Brights Hard Enamel Nonstick 6-Quart Covered Stockpot. This versatile cookware comes in the perfect size to handle family-sized one-pot meals like Rach's Sausage and Shrimp One-Pot. Combining superior performance, fun contemporary color and durable materials, this stockpot is ideal for Rachael's Steakhouse Chili Pot. The pot's sturdy construction promotes even heating, helping to reduce hot spots that can burn foods, and the two-tone bold enamel exterior shows plenty of stylish kitchen personality. A durable nonstick interior provides superior food release and makes cleanup a breeze. Oven safe to 350° F, the stockpot's comfortable grippy handles are double riveted for extra strength, while a shatter-resistant, tempered glass lid seals in heat and flavor even as you watch ingredients cook up. Discover a fun and stylish stockpot that makes one-pot meals everyday easy with the bold and contemporary Rachael Ray Classic Brights Hard Enamel Nonstick 6-Quart Covered Stockpot.
